transformations.rationale: Adapted the Rust method signature to Verus named return syntax while preserving the generated `vec_into_iter_remaining_mut` postcondition.
Modeled the private `as_raw_mut_slice` callee as a narrow target-local boundary carrying the raw mutable slice view relation to `vec_into_iter_remaining_mut`.
Isolated only the Rust 1.96 raw slice dereference `&mut *...` in a named external-body helper; the public target method is executable and not external-body.
